description: Add one macro knob (a 0–1 custom parameter) to a COMP that drives many parameters at once, each remapped into its own [min,max] range with an optional response curve — a one-to-many control for sweeping a whole look from a single fader. Targets are bound by expression so they track the macro live.

comp_path.description: COMP that will hold the macro knob (usually a control-panel container).

targets.description: Parameters this macro drives, each remapped from the macro's 0–1 into [min,max].

curve.description: Response curve exponent: 1 = linear, >1 = ease-in, <1 = ease-out.

max.description: Value this target takes when the macro is at 1.

min.description: Value this target takes when the macro is at 0.

name: create_macro
title: Create macro control
